notes: Item 19 is fully disclosed. Three parts: Part A (162 Qualified Studios by quartile for Gross Revenue, Monthly Active Members, Monthly New Memberships for full-year 2024), Part B (New Studios month-by-month ramp data for Months 1-12 post-Soft Opening in 2024), and Part C (Revenue mix percentages for 162 Qualified Studios). All values extracted directly from tables. Part B Month 12 has only 1 studio so min/max/median all equal the average. Revenue mix percentages treated as unit_period=null since they are dimensionless ratios. The Fees maximum is listed as 1% same as average - this appears to reflect rounding in the source document.
